seo.title: Frost Brew — bottled cold brew delivered in Tashkent
seo.description: Cold coffee steeped for 18 hours in 330 ml bottles: classic, vanilla, orange and decaf. Delivery across Tashkent, a weekly subscription and 40 points of sale.
seo.answer: Frost Brew is cold brew in 330 ml bottles, made in Sergeli and sold at 40 points across Tashkent. A bottle costs 26,000 UZS, a six-pack 145,000 UZS and a weekly office subscription from 420,000 UZS. Delivery across Tashkent Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 8 pm.

sections.title: Cold. Strong. Honest.
sections.subtitle: Colombian beans steep for 18 hours in cold water, then get filtered and bottled straight away. No sugar, no preservatives, keeps 21 days in the fridge.

sections.label: How we brew
sections.title: Time instead of heat
sections.text: Hot water pulls bitterness out of coffee in minutes, cold water pulls sweetness out in hours. We steep the beans for 18 hours at 4 °C in our Sergeli workshop, filter through paper and bottle the same day. The bottles are glass, and we take empties back for a discount.
